type: Original sculptural 3D empty-state illustration for the Nana social iOS app
goal: Create an original small app illustration, not a UI mockup. Authored specifically for Nana; not stock art or a copy of any existing mascot.

style.rendering: Soft handcrafted ceramic and satin resin, editorial miniature sculpture, rounded asymmetrical shapes, crisp readable silhouette at 100pt, restrained glossy edges
style.color_palette: violet #8B32FF, pale lavender #DCC8FF, warm ivory #FFF8EF, tiny muted coral accent
style.lighting: soft studio key light from upper left, subtle lilac reflected edge light, no heavy glow

background.type: Genuinely transparent alpha, no background plane, no white square, no checkerboard, no vignette

format.composition_safety: Centered isolated cluster taking 78% of square canvas; all objects entirely inside frame with 10% clear margins

avoid: any words, letters, numbers or labels
SF Symbols or flat outline icons
sad faces, error badges, red alert dots

character.subject: A tiny inviting live studio waiting for friends
character.metaphor_object: A sculptural pale-lavender retro video camera, viewed three-quarter, with a large layered violet circular lens and small ivory handle; perched on a low soft violet pebble-shaped studio platform. Beside it rests one rounded ivory speech bubble sculpture tilted gently toward the lens, its face entirely blank. One small coral four-point sparkle floating above.
